reviewTitle: I was new to packing cubes - they worked nicely
reviewDescription: I always thought I packed well by filling the nooks and crannies. I read about packing cubes and didn't see how they could help. The compression idea sounded good. We were going on a trip where we would be staying one night and moving on for a whole week, so the suitcase wouldn't get fully unpacked, but I could see it wouldn't stay organized. It was time to give packing cubes a try. I was quite happy with how it worked out. Never having used them, it was hard to figure out what I needed. This item gave me 6 cubes in different sizes and each had the compression zipper. There is a mesh top so you can see what is in the cube. At the time, it was at a very good sale price, so I wasn't taking a big gamble. I look forward to giving them a try again.

reviewDescription: As a mom of 4, I’m always looking for ways to make packing less stressful, especially when I’m packing for multiple kids at once. These packing cubes were so helpful for keeping everything organized and easy to find. I was able to fit a surprising amount inside — sweaters, tanks, pajamas, smaller toiletries, and more — without everything becoming a mess in the suitcase. I also really loved the smaller zippered compartments for little items that usually get lost at the bottom of a bag. They’re especially great for kids because I can separate outfits or categories for each child and keep everything neat while traveling. Definitely one of those products that makes mom life and travel feel a little easier.
